A '''city''' existed somewhere in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that was home to a [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] [[Unidentified Podracing city course|course]]. The [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] [[Wan Sandage Jr.]], [[Kraid Nemmeso]], and [[Aldar Beedo/Legends|Aldar Beedo]] raced on it during [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]]. Nemmeso and Beedo were caught in a collision with each other on the course while trying to down Sandage's [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]].<ref name="RR" />

==Behind the scenes==
This [[Planet/Legends|planet]] first appeared in the [[2002]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]''. The course and planet only appear in the game's opening cutscene, and does not appear anywhere else in the game.<ref name="RR" />
